verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any npm control over data retention or deletion, such as retention settings, account or data deletion, or privacy controls. A 2016 community remark that authors can delete published packages concerns registry mutability in the left-pad incident, not a documented privacy-retention capability. Running your own registry and setting `"private": true` are adjacent workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
